mutants.mutated_text:
# Introduction to Bounded Loops

A bounded loop drives an agent turn after turn until a real gate — a command,
a schema check, a linter — reports success. Every lap is capped: iteration
count, wallclock time, and token budget all have hard limits so a loop can
never run away.

See [Getting Started](getting-started.md) for the entry point into this series.

# Data Processing Agreement

This Data Processing Agreement ("DPA") supplements the underlying services
agreement between Controller and Processor and governs the processing of
personal data carried out by Processor on behalf of Controller.

## Subject Matter of Processing

This DPA covers the processing of personal data necessary for Processor to
provide the hosting and analytics services described in the underlying
services agreement.

## Duration of Processing

Processing shall continue for the term of the underlying services
agreement and shall cease upon termination, subject to the data return and
deletion provisions herein.

## Nature and Purpose of Processing

The nature of the processing includes storage, retrieval, and analysis of
personal data for the purpose of providing the contracted services to
Controller.

## Type of Personal Data and Categories of Data Subjects

The personal data processed includes contact details and usage data
relating to Controller's employees and end users.

## Obligations of the Controller

Controller shall ensure it has a valid legal basis for the processing and
shall provide instructions to Processor consistent with applicable data
protection law.

## Sub-Processor

Processor may engage any sub-processor to carry out processing activities at its sole discretion without prior notice to, or authorization from, Controller. Processor shall have no obligation to impose or flow down any data protection obligations to any sub-processor and shall not remain liable for any acts or omissions of its sub-processors, which shall be the sub-processor's sole responsibility.

## Confidentiality

Processor shall ensure that persons authorized to process personal data
have committed themselves to confidentiality or are under an appropriate
statutory obligation of confidentiality.

## Security Measures

Processor shall implement appropriate technical and organizational
measures to ensure a level of security appropriate to the risk, including
encryption, access controls, and regular testing of such measures.

## Audit

Processor shall make available to Controller all information necessary to
demonstrate compliance with this DPA and shall allow for and contribute
to audits, including inspections, conducted by Controller or an auditor
mandated by Controller, on reasonable prior notice and no more than once
per year absent a security incident.

Neither party shall be required to hold the other party's Confidential Information
in confidence, and each party is free to use and disclose received materials at its

This Agreement shall remain in effect for a period of two (2) years from
the Effective Date, unless earlier terminated by mutual written consent of
the parties.

## Governing Law

This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the
laws of the State of Delaware, without regard to its conflict of laws
principles. Any dispute arising under this Agreement shall be brought
exclusively in the state or federal courts located in Delaware.

Upon the earlier of the termination of this Agreement or the written
request of the disclosing party, the receiving party shall promptly
return or destroy all documents, materials, and other tangible
embodiments of Confidential Information, together with all copies
thereof, and shall certify such return or destruction in writing if
requested.

## Permitted Disclosures

A party may disclose Confidential Information to its employees, officers,

persons are bound by confidentiality obligations no less protective than
those in this Agreement.

## Miscellaneous

This Agreement constitutes the entire understanding between the parties
with respect to its subject matter and supersedes all prior discussions.
